label: Mexico's government found it, not America
description: Something uncovered by the government of Mexico rather than by America, which he finds significant, given alongside the fires and something underground that he says bothered him a lot.
aliases: it's the government of Mexico, not America, that found this
this is what really bothered me a lot for the fires

label: Someone dies of the C word
description: A person seen with serious health problems he will only call the C word, who does not make it, seen while praying into the months ahead. He declines to say more.
aliases: it would be the C word and that's all I will say
it was very serious but they didn't make it

label: The Thunder lose the seventh game
description: Praying over the area where people gather at a named downtown park for the basketball games, with the team losing in the seventh game and something he says is trying to happen there.
aliases: thunder lost in the seventh game
praying over the thunder and thunder alley

label: Examining my troops: some will not make it
description: That God is examining his troops and that some of them will not make it to what he has called them to, given against the doubt and unbelief of an older generation that has never seen it before.
aliases: I'm examining my troops
there'll be some of them that will not make it

label: What is being pushed on English children comes to America
description: Something being introduced in English schools that he says will be pushed on American children in the coming days if the country does not wake up.
aliases: this is coming to America if you don't wake up
the trash they're going to push on our kids

label: Crowds still chanting death to America after the strikes
description: Crowds in Iran seen on video chanting death to America after American action, which he contrasts with the stated aim of liberating and helping them, saying he does not understand it.
aliases: crying out death to America all across over in Iran right now
We're trying to liberate you

label: A floor rising into a golden circle and another above it
description: A floor seen going up in a perfect even golden circle into another one above it, with the Lord saying that is what he is praying into, and the American flag visible.
aliases: it went up in a golden curb
a beautiful round circle that was completely even
That's what you're praying into

label: Eight thousand watching is enough to change nations
description: That the eight thousand people watching live could change the nations, set against the eight billion in the world, with the point that God does not need many.
aliases: All 8,000 of you. God could change the nations
He doesn't need a whole lot

label: This is the final chapter and the finale
description: Old chapters closing and a brand new one beginning, called the final chapter and the finale, seen with fireworks while looking at a named minister's face in what he calls the spirit room.
aliases: This is the final chapter. This is it. The revival
This is the finale

label: A sonar-like coded signal running down to South America
description: A signal heard like sonar, a repeated ping, running down to South America, described as a mathematical code that only they know.
aliases: I hear a signal. Kind of like a sonar
It's a mathematical code that they only know
